items.why: Citi raised its price target to $800 from $575 and Mizuho to $705, citing Meta's Muse AI agent as a huge driver of chip demand. CEO Lisa Su said AMD will substantially increase supply in 2027.
Prime Big Deal Days kicked off today and run through Oct 7 across 22 countries, pulling attention to the retail engine just as coverage debates whether the stock is due for a big rally.
Melius Research upgraded the stock to Buy with a $665 target, calling Microsoft the 'adults in charge' of AI as enterprises seek trusted platforms amid growing AI safety concerns.
No single headline; the fear gauge fell as equities hit record highs with the Nasdaq notching its 23rd record close of the year.

market_note: Futures faded midday; VIX eased 2.19% as fear gauge demand dropped with equities at highs.
summary: Record-setting day. The S&P 500 hit a new high as falling oil prices and easing Treasury yields lifted stocks, and the AI trade stayed in charge with chips and mega caps leading.
